description: Repo-scale (php-library): LoanService::bulkTransferLoans must validate every loan is currently active BEFORE transferring any of them (atomic), plus a destination-member maxActiveLoans check
prompts: Members gain an optional `maxActiveLoans` field (a non-negative integer, or null meaning unlimited) - accept it as an optional third constructor/`create()` argument. Add `LoanService::bulkTransferLoans(array $loanIds, int $newMemberId): array`, moving a batch of active loans to a different member. This must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate that EVERY loanId in the request exists and is currently active BEFORE transferring any of them - if one isn't, throw LibraryException and leave every loan exactly where it was, not partially transferred; (2) validate that moving the WHOLE batch into the destination member wouldn't push their active-loan count over their maxActiveLoans, again before transferring anything. Return the array of moved loans.

test_setup_files.tests/BulkTransferLoansTest.php:
<?php

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/LoanService.php';

final class BulkTransferLoansTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testTransferIsAtomicOnNonActiveLoan(): void
    {
        $books = new \App\BookRepository();
        $members = new \App\MemberRepository();
        $loans = new \App\LoanRepository();
        $service = new \App\LoanService($books, $members, $loans);

        $from = $members->create('Ada', 'a@example.com');
        $to = $members->create('Bob', 'b@example.com');
        $b1 = $books->create('A', 'x', 1);
        $b2 = $books->create('B', 'x', 1);

        $active = $service->borrow($b1->id, $from->id);
        $returned = $service->borrow($b2->id, $from->id);
        $service->returnLoan($returned->id);

        $threw = false;
        try {
            $service->bulkTransferLoans([$active->id, $returned->id], $to->id);
        } catch (\App\LibraryException $e) {
            $threw = true;
        }
        $this->assertTrue($threw, 'expected a LibraryException');
        $this->assertSame($from->id, $active->memberId, 'active loan must remain with the original member');
    }

    public function testTransferRespectsDestinationCapacity(): void
    {
        $books = new \App\BookRepository();
        $members = new \App\MemberRepository();
        $loans = new \App\LoanRepository();
        $service = new \App\LoanService($books, $members, $loans);

        $from = $members->create('Ada', 'a@example.com');
        $to = $members->create('Bob', 'b@example.com', 1);
        $b1 = $books->create('A', 'x', 1);
        $b2 = $books->create('B', 'x', 1);

        $l1 = $service->borrow($b1->id, $from->id);
        $l2 = $service->borrow($b2->id, $from->id);

        $this->expectException(\App\LibraryException::class);
        $service->bulkTransferLoans([$l1->id, $l2->id], $to->id);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/Member.php';

class MemberRepository
{
    /** @var array<int, Member> */
    private array $members = [];
    private int $nextId = 1;

    public function create(string $name, string $email, ?int $maxActiveLoans = null): Member
    {
        $member = new Member($this->nextId, $name, $email, $maxActiveLoans);
        $this->members[$member->id] = $member;
        $this->nextId++;
        return $member;
    }

    public function find(int $id): ?Member
    {
        return $this->members[$id] ?? null;
    }

    /** @return Member[] */
    public function all(): array
    {
        $members = array_values($this->members);
        usort($members, fn(Member $a, Member $b) => $a->id <=> $b->id);
        return $members;
    }
}
reference_solution.src/LoanService.php:
<?php

namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/BookRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/MemberRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LoanRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LibraryException.php';

class LoanService
{
    private BookRepository $books;
    private MemberRepository $members;
    private LoanRepository $loans;

    public function __construct(BookRepository $books, MemberRepository $members, LoanRepository $loans)
    {
        $this->books = $books;
        $this->members = $members;
        $this->loans = $loans;
    }

    public function borrow(int $bookId, int $memberId): Loan
    {
        $book = $this->books->find($bookId);
        if ($book === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('book not found');
        }
        $member = $this->members->find($memberId);
        if ($member === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('member not found');
        }
        if ($book->availableCopies <= 0) {
            throw new LibraryException('no copies available');
        }

        $book->availableCopies--;
        return $this->loans->create($bookId, $memberId, 'active');
    }

    /**
     * Moves a batch of active loans to a different member. Must be
     * atomic in two ways: (1) validate every loanId exists and is
     * currently active BEFORE transferring any of them - one bad id
     * anywhere in the list leaves every loan exactly where it was; (2)
     * validate the WHOLE batch's combined size against the destination
     * member's maxActiveLoans (existing active loans + batch size),
     * again before transferring anything.
     *
     * @param int[] $loanIds
     * @return Loan[]
     */
    public function bulkTransferLoans(array $loanIds, int $newMemberId): array
    {
        $newMember = $this->members->find($newMemberId);
        if ($newMember === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('member not found');
        }
        if (count($loanIds) === 0) {
            throw new LibraryException('loanIds must not be empty');
        }

        $targets = [];
        foreach ($loanIds as $loanId) {
            $loan = $this->loans->find($loanId);
            if ($loan === null) {
                throw new LibraryException('loan not found');
            }
            if ($loan->status !== 'active') {
                throw new LibraryException('loan is not active');
            }
            $targets[] = $loan;
        }

        if ($newMember->maxActiveLoans !== null) {
            $current = count(array_filter($this->loans->forMember($newMemberId), fn(Loan $l) => $l->status === 'active'));
            $incoming = count(array_filter($targets, fn(Loan $l) => $l->memberId !== $newMemberId));
            if ($current + $incoming > $newMember->maxActiveLoans) {
                throw new LibraryException('member is already at maximum active loans');
            }
        }

        foreach ($targets as $loan) {
            $loan->memberId = $newMemberId;
        }
        return $targets;
    }

    public function returnLoan(int $loanId): Loan
    {
        $loan = $this->loans->find($loanId);
        if ($loan === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('loan not found');
        }
        if ($loan->status !== 'active') {
            throw new LibraryException('loan already returned');
        }

        $loan->status = 'returned';
        $book = $this->books->find($loan->bookId);
        if ($book !== null) {
            $book->availableCopies++;
        }
        return $loan;
    }
}
